summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised to ¥18.00 from ¥16.00 (FY12/26). New dividend policy adopts DOE (equity dividend payout ratio) floor of 4.0% effective FY12/26, replacing prior 40% earnings-based payout-ratio target. Policy aims to prioritize growth investment while ensuring disciplined capital returns.
title_en: Notice on Revision of Dividend Policy (Introduction of DOE) and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Sincere Co., Ltd. announced on 15 June 2026 a revision to its dividend policy and an increase to its FY12/26 dividend forecast. The full-year dividend per share has been raised from ¥16.00 to ¥18.00, an increase of ¥2.00. The company has replaced its prior earnings-linked payout-ratio target of 40% with a new dividend policy anchored to DOE (equity dividend payout ratio), establishing a floor of 4.0%. Under the revised policy, the company will prioritize growth investment and strategic capital allocation while systematically returning excess capital to shareholders. The new policy will take effect from the FY12/26 dividend onward. The company notes that material changes to capital structure resulting from large-scale M&A would trigger a comprehensive review of shareholder-return strategy including dividend policy.
